title: Edge: a delta that rounds to zero shows 0.0 in the default color, and negatives always use an explicit minus with one decimal
preconditions: 1. If producible, an invoice whose delta is tiny (e.g., +0.04) and one with a small negative delta (e.g., -0.5) exist.
steps: 1. Read the tiny-delta invoice's Inv. Hrs.
2. Read the small-negative invoice's Inv. Hrs.
expected: 1. A value that rounds to 0.0 (e.g., +0.04) shows 0.0 in the default color — not +0.0 in green.
2. Negative values always use an explicit minus and one decimal (e.g., -0.5).
